tagline.en: Southern Illinois to Chattanooga over Monteagle Mountain
tagline.zh: 自南伊利诺伊越蒙蒂格尔山至查塔努加

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 伊利诺伊州普利斯米尔，与 I-57 相接

end.zh: 田纳西州查塔努加，与 I-75 相接

en: I-24 runs diagonally from southern Illinois to south-eastern Tennessee, crossing the Ohio River at Paducah, cutting through western Kentucky past the lakes, running the length of Middle Tennessee through Nashville and Murfreesboro, and climbing the Cumberland Plateau to reach Chattanooga. On the way it clips the north-western corner of Georgia for four miles.

Its defining piece of ground is Monteagle Mountain. Tennessee was known as a detour state in the 1920s precisely because the plateau could not be crossed reliably, and on the climb the two carriageways of I-24 separate by a considerable distance because the terrain gives them no choice. The eastbound side was built on what had been a three-lane stretch of US 41 and US 64.

At the other end of the scale is Nashville, one of only four American cities where six Interstate legs converge inside the city limits. The stretch of I-24 south-east of the city towards Murfreesboro is both a commuter route and a freight route, and is the most congested corridor in Tennessee.
zh: I-24 自南伊利诺伊斜穿至田纳西东南部：在帕迪尤卡跨越俄亥俄河，经西肯塔基的湖区，沿田纳西中部纵贯纳什维尔与默夫里斯伯勒，再攀上坎伯兰高原抵达查塔努加。途中它还切过佐治亚西北角，行程四英里。
决定它性格的地形是蒙蒂格尔山。田纳西在 1920 年代之所以被称作「绕道州」，正是因为这片高原无法可靠地翻越；而在这段爬坡上，I-24 的两条行车道被迫相距甚远，因为地形不容它们靠近。东行一侧修建在原 US 41 与 US 64 的一段三车道路面上。
另一端的极致是纳什维尔——全美仅有四座城市在市界内有六条州际公路分支交汇，它是其中之一。该市东南通往默夫里斯伯勒的 I-24 路段既是通勤线也是货运线，是田纳西最拥堵的走廊。

en: As proposed in the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956, this route ran only from Nashville to Chattanooga. Most of that was built in the 1960s — the Ridge Cut through Chattanooga was dedicated on 1 December 1965, the Monteagle crossing was built between 1962 and 1968 — and the last piece of it opened in 1971.

The road became a four-state route because of politics. After lobbying by local officials, the Bureau of Public Roads authorised an extension north-west to Pulleys Mill, Illinois, in 1964. Illinois got engineering approval by 1966 and construction approval by 1968, and its first section, between Vienna and Metropolis, was opened by the governor in January 1974. The stretch from Metropolis across the Ohio River to Paducah followed that October — the first piece of I-24 to open in Kentucky as well as the second in Illinois. Illinois finished in January 1976.

Kentucky took longest. Ground was broken in Lyon County in December 1967, the 28 miles from US 68 to the Tennessee line opened in September 1975, and the route was finally completed on 23 May 1980 when a 23-mile section east of Cadiz opened. I-24 was the last mainline Interstate to be finished in both Tennessee, in 1978, and Kentucky.
zh: 按 1956 年《联邦补助公路法》的构想，这条路线仅自纳什维尔通往查塔努加。其中大部分建于 1960 年代——穿过查塔努加的「山脊切口」于 1965 年 12 月 1 日举行通车典礼，蒙蒂格尔越岭段建于 1962 至 1968 年间——最后一块于 1971 年通车。

它之所以成为跨四州的路线，源于政治。在地方官员游说之后，公共道路局于 1964 年批准向西北延伸至伊利诺伊州普利斯米尔。伊利诺伊在 1966 年获得勘察设计批准、1968 年获得施工批准，其第一段（维也纳至梅特罗波利斯）由州长在 1974 年 1 月主持通车。同年 10 月，自梅特罗波利斯跨俄亥俄河至帕迪尤卡的路段跟进——这既是 I-24 在肯塔基通车的第一段，也是在伊利诺伊通车的第二段。伊利诺伊于 1976 年 1 月完工。
肯塔基耗时最久。1967 年 12 月在里昂县破土，1975 年 9 月通车自 US 68 至田纳西州界的 28 英里，而全线最终于 1980 年 5 月 23 日贯通——当日卡迪兹以东 23 英里路段通车。在田纳西（1978 年）与肯塔基，I-24 都是最后建成的主干州际公路。

en: The Ohio River crossing at Paducah has been the route's weak point twice over. The twin tied-arch bridge opened in October 1974 without a dedication ceremony, and within five years inspectors found cracks in its tie girders caused by defective welding. The span was closed in 1979, stayed shut to all traffic until October 1980 and to trucks until the summer of 1981 — barely a year after the route had been completed end to end.

The current problem is capacity between Nashville and Murfreesboro. Traffic in the Rutherford County segments has risen by more than 60 per cent since 2005, and Tennessee DOT has concluded that further widening is neither financially feasible nor a solution. Its answer was first an integrated corridor management project — variable speed limits, lane control, ramp metering, and coordination with the parallel arterial — and then a proposal for the state's first tolled Choice Lanes, to be delivered as a public–private partnership under 2023 state legislation.

The reasoning behind that structure is arithmetic. Widening the corridor conventionally would cost several times the department's entire annual work programme, which is why the state went looking for private capital rather than simply for lanes.
zh: 帕迪尤卡的俄亥俄河跨河段两度成为这条路线的软肋。这座双拱系杆桥于 1974 年 10 月通车，未举行任何典礼；不到五年，检查人员便在其系杆梁上发现了因焊接缺陷造成的裂缝。桥梁于 1979 年关闭，对所有车辆的封闭持续至 1980 年 10 月，对货车的封闭则延续到 1981 年夏——距全线贯通仅一年有余。
当前的问题是纳什维尔至默夫里斯伯勒之间的通行能力。拉瑟福德县各路段的车流量自 2005 年以来增长逾 60%，田纳西州交通部认定继续拓宽既不具财务可行性，也解决不了问题。其对策先是一个综合走廊管理项目——可变限速、车道控制、匝道信号，并与平行的主干道协同——随后又提出该州首个收费的「选择车道」方案，依 2023 年州立法以政府与社会资本合作方式实施。
这一安排背后的逻辑是算术。按常规方式拓宽这条走廊的费用，将是该部门全年工作计划预算的数倍，这正是该州转而寻求私人资本、而非直接修车道的原因。

value.en: $676.2 million — Tennessee $326.9 million, Kentucky $240.4 million, Illinois $101.1 million, Georgia $7.8 million. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 6.762 亿美元——田纳西 3.269 亿、肯塔基 2.404 亿、伊利诺伊 1.011 亿、佐治亚 780 万美元。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

timeline.en: The Federal-Aid Highway Act proposes the route, from Nashville to Chattanooga only.
timeline.zh: 《联邦补助公路法》提出这条路线，范围仅自纳什维尔至查塔努加。

timeline.en: Construction of the Monteagle Mountain crossing begins.
timeline.zh: 蒙蒂格尔山越岭段动工。

timeline.en: The Bureau of Public Roads authorises the extension north-west to Pulleys Mill, Illinois.
timeline.zh: 公共道路局批准向西北延伸至伊利诺伊州普利斯米尔。

timeline.en: The Ridge Cut through Chattanooga is dedicated on 1 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 1 日，穿过查塔努加的「山脊切口」举行通车典礼。

timeline.en: Ground is broken on the first Kentucky stretch in Lyon County on 6 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 6 日，肯塔基首段在里昂县破土动工。

timeline.en: Illinois opens its first section in January; the Ohio River bridge at Paducah opens on 18 October.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊首段于 1 月通车；帕迪尤卡俄亥俄河大桥于 10 月 18 日通车。

timeline.en: Illinois completes its section on 24 January.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊段于 1 月 24 日建成。

timeline.en: Tennessee finishes its section, the last mainline Interstate to be completed in the state.
timeline.zh: 田纳西段建成，是该州最后建成的主干州际公路。

timeline.en: Cracked tie girders close the Paducah Bridge.
timeline.zh: 系杆梁开裂导致帕迪尤卡大桥关闭。

timeline.en: The final 23 miles in Kentucky open on 23 May, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 肯塔基最后 23 英里于 5 月 23 日通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: Tennessee awards the SMART Corridor construction contract in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，田纳西授出智慧走廊施工合同。
